slides.title: They said yes. *Then they ghosted.*
slides.body: The framework I use to turn a positive call into a payment.

slides.title: Deposits before *withdrawals*
slides.body: Give value, listen, make them feel heard. Then ask.

slides.title: They understand they have a *problem*
slides.body: Ask questions until they say it out loud.

slides.title: They trust you to *fix it*
slides.body: Don't say “we can fix that.” Show exactly how.

slides.title: They have a way to *pay you now*
slides.body: Payment link ready before the call ends.

slides.title: Actions they take *only with you*
slides.body: A lead magnet, a video, a reply. Track it with an engagement score.

slides.title: Get paid *live*
slides.body: If it feels high pressure, you haven't sold them yet.

slides.title: *Reinforce* the decision
slides.body: A thank-you, something extra. Buyer's remorse is real.

slides.title: Comment *PAYMENT*
slides.body: Positive reactions mean nothing until they turn into payment.
